Clear the global MRMhub plot defaults

Source: R/plot-defaults.R
mrmhub_reset_plot_defaults.Rd

Removes all mrmhub.* plot-appearance options set by mrmhub_set_plot_defaults(), restoring the built-in per-function defaults.

Usage

mrmhub_reset_plot_defaults()

Value

Invisibly, the previous option values (as returned by options()).

See also

mrmhub_set_plot_defaults()

Examples

mrmhub_set_plot_defaults(font_base_size = 8)
mrmhub_reset_plot_defaults()
